explanation: The anthem, 'Oben am jungen Rhein', sets German words about the young Rhine to the British tune, so the melody is played twice when England meet Liechtenstein at football (soccer).

claims.text: Liechtenstein's national anthem, 'Oben am jungen Rhein', uses the same melody as the British national anthem.
Liechtenstein's anthem has German words about the young Rhine.
When England and Liechtenstein play each other at football (soccer), the same melody is played for both national anthems.
